pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Shapes are predominantly four-to-six-sided on the mid-flank, exhibiting a significant reduction in spatial area and increased fragmentation as they progress toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A high-continuity negative-space graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes typically represent tri-radial intersections. The pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively wide and stable across the upper flank but demonstrates narrowing and increased complexity near the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency textural silhouette characteristic of a short mane, though sharpness is degraded by focal blur and partially obscured by an external biological entity.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of a dark avian subject (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper neck and shoulder.
